title: Defense-as-Skill: Evolving Runtime Guard Skill for Skill-Augmented Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.01487v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Skill-augmented agents load reusable skills as persistent runtime context, improving task performance but also giving malicious skills a durable channel for steering future actions. Such skills may leak secrets, corrupt code, bypass approvals, or stage data for exfiltration only after a concrete user task and workspace state make the unsafe action appear useful. This makes pre-install vetting insufficient and calls for runtime, task-conditioned protection. We propose Defense-as-Skill, a defense paradigm that implements the runtime guard itself as an installable, inspectable, and editable skill. Our guard, SkillSonar, runs alongside untrusted task skills and checks sensitive actions against the user's task boundary, routing each action to an allow, replan, or confirmation decision without modifying the underlying agent runtime. translated_title: 防御即技能：为技能增强型智能体演化运行时守卫技能
translated_abstract: 技能增强型智能体将可复用技能作为持久的运行时上下文进行加载，这虽然提升了任务性能，但也为恶意技能开辟了一条持久通道，使其能够影响智能体未来的行动。此类技能可能在具体用户任务和工作区状态使不安全操作显得有用时，才泄露机密、破坏代码、绕过审批，或暂存数据以待外泄。这使得仅靠安装前的审查已不再足够，需要运行时的、任务条件化的保护。我们提出 Defense-as-Skill（防御即技能），一种将运行时守卫本身实现为可安装、可检查、可编辑技能的防御范式。我们的守卫 SkillSonar 与不可信的任务技能并行运行，依据用户的任务边界对敏感操作进行检查，并将每个操作路由至允许、重新规划或请求确认的决策，而无需修改底层智能体运行时。为研究这一场景，我们构建了 SCOPE-R，一个任务条件化的数据集，涵盖 6 个风险类别和 21 个子类别。
tldr: 提出“防御即技能”新范式，将运行时安全守卫 SkillSonar 本身实现为可安装、可检查、可编辑的技能，使其与不可信任务技能并行运行，并依据用户任务边界对敏感操作进行条件化检查（允许、重新规划或确认），同时构建了覆盖 6 个风险类别的 SCOPE-R 数据集。
en_tdlr: Defense-as-Skill implements the runtime guard itself as an installable, inspectable, and editable skill—SkillSonar—which runs alongside untrusted task skills and routes sensitive actions to allow, replan, or confirmation decisions based on the user's task boundary, evaluated on the task-conditioned SCOPE-R dataset covering 6 risk families.
